$comment: Pages bundled into the iPhone app (docs/ios/OMC_APP_ROADMAP.md). Read by scripts/build-app-shell.mjs (what to copy) and src/lib/native/links.ts (what stays in the app; everything else opens on the website). Patterns match a path without a trailing slash. Never add public sales pages, checkout, billing (/club/dashboard), admin or the Club offer (/club). inAppRewrites: website pages whose in-app equivalent is a bundled page (the Club's sales page → Club Home), so a member's back link never leaves the app.
